scenicChapters.title: Passo di Vivione
scenicChapters.narrative: 27 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Mortirolo Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 19 km this is Mortirolo Pass Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
